open_decisions.question: When may a filing package be called complete?
open_decisions.proposed_answer: Declare separate acquired-unit, reviewed-assertion and query-exposure populations and retain material unresolved incorporated targets.
open_decisions.alternative: A single completeness score or closure only over acquired files.
open_decisions.consequence: An aggregate score could conceal absent contracts and overstate downstream support.
open_decisions.next_step: Specify a reconciled annual/interim package with duplicate, unavailable, ambiguous and resource-limited references and query consequences.

open_decisions.question: How does a narrative reading become a constraint?
open_decisions.proposed_answer: Bind scope, time, modality, exceptions and contexts explicitly; accept translation separately and label added thresholds as assumptions.
open_decisions.alternative: Free-text scope with generic acceptance and implementation-defined translation.
open_decisions.consequence: Implementations could turn permissions into payments or fixed coupons into fixed aggregate exposure.
open_decisions.next_step: Specify positive and rejected translations and unresolved-predicate effects in the evidence/language contracts.

open_decisions.question: May source preparation infer a half-unit interval from displayed precision when the rounding rule is unknown?
open_decisions.proposed_answer: Separate display precision from the issuer rounding convention; retain unknowns and permit a named conditional nearest-rounding compatibility model with explicit assumption provenance.
open_decisions.alternative: Treat the displayed unit as sufficient evidence for a half-unit interval, or reject all conditional rounding analysis.
open_decisions.consequence: The first overstates source support; the second prevents useful conditional analysis. Existing P02 and the general contract are not yet aligned on this distinction.
open_decisions.next_step: Inspect the unit and rounding disclosures, distinguish unknown nearest convention from unknown tie rule, and specify assumption-labelled examples with missing and known rounding metadata.

open_decisions.question: Which missing time/version fields may a query tolerate?
open_decisions.proposed_answer: Keep exploratory archival results explicitly qualified; reject or return unresolved for system-as-of claims without ingestion evidence and for investor-information evaluation without justified availability and byte vintage.
open_decisions.alternative: Carry P06 defaults forward: infer ingestion from availability and select unknown-vintage bytes by default.
open_decisions.consequence: The alternative can produce results labelled as historical knowledge that the retained evidence does not establish.
open_decisions.next_step: Specify distinct query admission modes and fixtures for absent versus explicit-null ingestion, unknown publication and unverified bytes, then reconcile P06 with the proposal.

open_decisions.question: What does review acceptance authorise across extraction and interpretation layers?
open_decisions.proposed_answer: Name the accepted layer, preserve alternatives/conflicts, and propagate status and transitive invalidation through explicit dependencies.
open_decisions.alternative: One undifferentiated accepted status usable as an accounting constraint.
open_decisions.consequence: A faithful extraction of a disputed or incorrect assertion could otherwise become an endorsed treatment.
open_decisions.next_step: Specify a real source-backed conflict walkthrough and cross-layer transition/admission examples under MC04/MC27 before general workflow acceptance.

open_decisions.question: Which initial profile should be proposed for implementation?
open_decisions.proposed_answer: Compare a bounded corporate history profile, a typed-library/shared-IR profile and a financing-first profile on the same source, history, journal, statement and replay obligations; keep the outcome provisional until P16 review.
open_decisions.alternative: Adopt Core 0/Northstar because its prototype exists, or choose the broadest cross-standard scope before fixtures exist.
open_decisions.consequence: Prototype availability is not evidence of architectural fit; a premature choice could conceal missing package, entity and timing semantics.
open_decisions.next_step: Run the P16 profile comparison with explicit inclusion/exclusion, dependencies, acceptance fixtures and vetoes.

open_decisions.question: What authority is sufficient for cross-standard and sector treatment claims?
open_decisions.proposed_answer: Admit only dated, locally archived primary passages and company facts within their scope; keep US GAAP/ASBE, bank prudential and broad insurance operations partial until inspected.
open_decisions.alternative: Treat overview material, company policy or illustrative arithmetic as general authority.
open_decisions.consequence: Unbounded authority would turn structural examples into unsupported accounting claims.
open_decisions.next_step: Build P17 method dossiers with rule versions, matched cases, source limits and unresolved operations.

open_decisions.question: What evidence is sufficient for an end-to-end proposal readiness claim?
open_decisions.proposed_answer: Require P15 coverage, P16 contracts, P17 methods, P18 rendered manuscript/build review and P19 independent review, with engineering, accounting, forecast and human states separate.
open_decisions.alternative: Treat passing structural checks, a compiled PDF or prototype phase acceptances as readiness.
open_decisions.consequence: Proxy evidence could incorrectly enable implementation or imply accounting validity.
open_decisions.next_step: Carry the separation into every later artifact and readiness decision.

open_decisions.question: How should unresolved branches and partial execution appear in outputs?
open_decisions.proposed_answer: Return explicit feasible/unknown/infeasible/unsupported/default/internal-failure statuses with branch lineage and retained unresolved mass; never silently drop or renormalize.
open_decisions.alternative: Return successful branches only or collapse unresolved branches into a default.
open_decisions.consequence: Downstream statements and forecasts would overstate certainty and lose dependence.
open_decisions.next_step: Specify result payloads and failure fixtures in P16/P17 before implementation.

candidate_initial_profile: Provisional bounded corporate-history profile: source/package and narrative coverage records; explicit entity/perimeter/time contexts; Core 0 or typed shared-IR authoring; rational-linear/finite-choice history construction; one bounded corporate event/journal/statement path; explicit review/persistence and replay; Northstar synthetic fixture plus a bounded Apple source-preparation fixture. It is a comparison candidate only, with bank, insurance, full cross-standard authority, general nonlinear inference, complete real semantic closure and production adapters excluded until specified.
profile_alternative: At minimum compare (A) the bounded corporate/shared-IR profile above, (B) typed-library-first with the same shared IR and no DSL commitment, and (C) financing/instrument-first profile with later corporate package. A broad multi-standard/bank/insurance-first profile is a fourth stress alternative. Compare all on identical source-to-record, joint-history, journal/statement, temporal-query, review/invalidation, persistence/replay and acceptance obligations; prototype code availability is not a selection criterion.
selection_question: Which candidate provides the smallest independently implementable slice that preserves whole-company requirements, joint histories, evidence clocks, accounting-layer separation and later extension points under explicit acceptance fixtures? P16 must document the comparison, vetoes, dependencies, workload and residual risks before any architecture is selected.
